answer: Palm-vein patterns lie under the skin and can only be read by near-infrared light, so a photo or a fake hand cannot pass. The vein map is hashed inside a secure enclave and only a signed match verdict leaves the device. The nectar of the method is that veins are hidden from sight, a vine of vessels is unique to each person, and basalt-hard liveness comes free — a severed or printed hand has no blood flow to reveal.
